parallel_tasks.title: Fix Three.js r170 Actor Facing Flip (`scale.x = -w` Ignored) & Cache-Hit Prop Rescaling
parallel_tasks.details: In `frontend/src/stage/ThreeStageManager.ts`: (1) Three.js r170 `sprite_vert` uses `length(modelMatrix[0].xyz)` which ignores negative `sprite.scale.x = -w` so Lia and Nyx NEVER flip left/right! Fix actor facing cleanly (e.g., maintain horizontally mirrored cloned `THREE.Texture` with `repeat.x = -1; offset.x = 1` or double-sided `PlaneGeometry` `THREE.Mesh`) so `facing: 'left' | 'right'` visibly flips characters on stage; (2) In `applyPropTexture()`, when `this.textureCache.get(effectiveUrl)` hits cache, it currently returns early without updating `ent.baseScale = this.fitScaleToBox(img.width, img.height, maxPropW, maxPropH)` — fix it so props transitioning between held (`0.30`) and table (`0.38`) rescale immediately.

parallel_tasks.title: Fix `handleForceRewrite` Target Stale-State Bug & Send `scene_id` in `createStageProp`
parallel_tasks.details: In `frontend/src/App.tsx`: `handleForceRewrite` calls `handleSubmitFork` without passing `pendingConflict.targetSceneId` and `pendingConflict.parentBranchId`; update `handleSubmitFork` to accept `{ targetSceneIdOverride, parentBranchIdOverride }` and pass `pendingConflict.targetSceneId` / `pendingConflict.parentBranchId` from `handleForceRewrite` so switching scenes/branches before clicking 'Force Rewrite Anyway' always targets the original conflict point. Also in `frontend/src/api/stageClient.ts` & `App.tsx`: pass `scene_id` in `createStageProp()` FormData so backend `branch.scenes` stays in lockstep.
